eyebrow: A smarter guide to understanding pain
welcomeTitle: A clearer pain map, a calmer decision
welcomeText: Explore 317 anatomical areas, describe your pain, and receive clear general guidance with safety alerts.
notDiagnosis: This app is educational and does not provide a diagnosis.

welcome.warningText: The app is educational and does not provide a diagnosis. In case of severe or sudden pain, shortness of breath, or fainting, seek urgent help.
welcome.disclaimer: Information is general and does not replace consultation with a qualified doctor.
welcome.quickCare: Quick self-care for neck, back and forearm

history.helperText: Checks are saved on this device only. They are not uploaded to any server.

details.redFlagsHint: Select only signs that are actually present. If you select one, stop self-care and seek urgent help.
details.urgentFlagText: The selected sign may require urgent assessment. Stop pressure and exercise and contact local emergency services.
details.highIntensityText: A high pain score alone cannot identify a cause or automatically mean an emergency. Seek prompt assessment if pain is new or worsening; seek emergency help for a warning sign.
details.contextHint: Record what you noticed only; this does not establish that a factor caused the pain.

results.shareDisclaimer: This is guidance information and not a medical diagnosis.
results.urgentText: The selected warning sign may require urgent care. Stop self-care and contact local emergency services now.
results.highIntensityText: A score alone does not diagnose the cause or automatically mean an emergency. Seek prompt medical assessment if pain is new or worsening.

bodyPicker.title: Interactive Muscle Map
bodyPicker.instruction: Choose the closest area, then review guidance and safety alerts. Pain location alone cannot diagnose the cause:
bodyPicker.noData: No detailed medical data available for this area currently.
bodyPicker.defaultDescription: Click below to see all recommendations and medical warnings for this muscle.
bodyPicker.showFullAnalysis: Show full analysis and medical data
bodyPicker.matching: Matching selected area with the 317 medical database...
bodyPicker.quickCareHint: Choose an area for gentle general guidance. Stop if pain worsens or a warning sign appears.
bodyPicker.organPainNotice: Pain location alone cannot identify an organ or cause. Unexplained chest, abdominal, or flank pain needs medical assessment; seek emergency help with shortness of breath or fainting.
bodyPicker.visualHintText: This image is an approximate visual guide. Tap a marker for a region, then use the 317-part map for finer selection.
bodyPicker.organImageHint: Simplified educational illustration; markers open general information and do not identify the cause of pain or diagnose an organ.
bodyPicker.organHint: Tap an organ location for general information; pain location alone cannot identify an organ or cause.
bodyPicker.anatomyMapHint: Choose an anatomical part on the interactive map, or search by name or number.
bodyPicker.mapAccessibilityLabel: Interactive anatomical map of muscle parts
bodyPicker.searchPlaceholder: Search by area name or part number
bodyPicker.noSearchResults: No matching parts in this view.
bodyPicker.defaultRecommendation: Seek medical evaluation if pain persists or worsens.
